basic_details.job_title: Chennai Port Authority Senior Deputy Chief Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 45 years. Age relaxation rules are not specified in the notification.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | senior dy. chief medical officer: (i) MBBS degree from a recognized university. (ii) A Post Graduate Degree or PG Medical Diploma in the specified specialty from a recognized university. (iii) Post qualification experience of 5 years in case of PG Degree holders and 12 years experience in case of PG Diploma holders in the relevant field of specialization in a reputed hospital.

salary_details.senior dy. chief medical officer: Rs.80000-220000 (Pre-revised scale of Rs.32900-58000 / 16000-20800) in Medical Department, Chennai Port Authority

selection_process: The selection is by merit for which overall grading in the ACRs / APARs will not be below "very good"
followed by the Services Selection Committee.
how_to_apply: Access the 'Online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
Fill out the online application form for the post of Senior Deputy Chief Medical Officer.
Take a print-out of the submitted online application form.
Attach copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates.
Enclose the undertaking of the applicant not to withdraw if selected (Annexure-5).
Attach a self-attested passport size photo to the application.
Ensure the application is forwarded through proper channel with all required documents to the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, Rajaji Salai, Chennai – 600001 on or before 22.11.2026.
important_instructions: Applications must be sent through proper channel along with the specified documents within the stipulated time. Applications received after 22.11.2026 without ACRs or enclosures will not be considered. Port officials who withdraw their candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy.HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years. The Port concerned shall ensure that the employee is relieved immediately in any case within 30 days of his / her present post in case of selection and appointment. Details of Major / Minor penalties and Vigilance Clearance clearly indicating whether the Officer is CLEAR / NOT-CLEAR from vigilance angle must be furnished.
